claims.text: The proposed supervision framework integrates questioning generation, reflection modeling, semantic calibration, and renewed reasoning into an iterative loop.
The questioning module produces structured queries on initial reasoning outputs to extract potential logical weaknesses.
The reflection module interprets questioning content, locates errors, and generates internal feedback signals.
The semantic calibration mechanism converts reflection outputs into intermediate states that influence the reasoning space.

methodologies.name: Cyclic Self-Questioning Supervision Framework
methodologies.description: An iterative supervision pipeline integrating questioning generation, reflection modeling, semantic calibration, and renewed reasoning to stabilize language model reasoning chains.
